details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept that beacons host metadata at install time. Its postinstall hook runs `node beacon.cjs`, and its index.js entry point also calls the same beacon on import, so merely resolving the package name triggers the callback. The beacon sends an HTTP POST of JSON — package name, os.hostname(), the __dirname install path, process.cwd(), and the npm user the publisher — to hxxp://185[.]158[.]107[.]175:8787/_ah/dc with an X-Beacon-Package header. It reads no environment variables, credentials, tokens or files, and executes no further code; index.js exports a no-op Proxy so that imports of the real package's members do not crash. The package README self-declares it as an authorized dependency-confusion test whose only function is reporting that it was installed.
